goldens.comment: Incorrect end time calculation using slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime
goldens.reasoning: C1 points out that the end time is computed from slotStartTime when it should use slotEndTime.

goldens.comment: Using === for dayjs object comparison will always return false as it compares object references, not values. Use .isSame() method instead: dayjs(date.start).add(utcOffset, 'minutes').isSame(dayjs(date.end).add(utcOffset, minutes))
goldens.reasoning: C2 points out that comparing two dayjs objects with === always returns false.

candidates: Copy-paste error: 'end' is computed from slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime, making 'end' always equal to 'start' - the working-hours boundary check only validates the slot's start minute, never its end, allowing bookings that overflow past working hours

Reference equality (===) on two distinct dayjs objects always evaluates to false - dayjs creates separate objects, so the condition to detect full-day-off date overrides never triggers, allowing bookings on days the organizer marked unavailable

Array.find() short-circuits on the first match - when multiple date overrides exist on the same day, a slot covered by a later override is incorrectly rejected because it falls outside the first override found
